# Anywhere Sync for DeepSeek Harness

Sync a Harness profile — installed plugins, plugin configuration, dependency
locks, local plugin sou

rce, skills and other profile files — across machines
through **one private Git repository**. Every

category is an independent
switch. A change made on one machine lands on the others at their next sy

中文说明
## Features

- **Six independently selectable sync items** — plugin manifest, local plugin
source, plugin configu

ration (`cordis.patch.yml`), dependency lock, other
profile files, and skills.
- **Three-way compari

son** — local, remote and the last synced hash; only a file
changed on both sides becomes a conflict

.
- **Conflict handling** — remote wins (default), local wins, or keep conflicts
and choose a side p

er file from the settings page.
- **Backups before every overwrite** — the last 10 runs under
`$DSH_

HOME/anywhere-sync/backups/`.
- **Automatic sync** — interval, sync on startup, and install dependen

cies after
a pulled plugin manifest.
- **The plugin itself syncs** — source of every `link:`/`file:`

plugin is stored
under `local-plugins/<package>/` and written back to the matching install
director

y on the other machines.
- **No machine paths in the repository** — `link:`/`file:`/absolute specs a

nd
their lockfile blocks are projected out before anything is pushed.
- **Agent tool** — `anywhere_s

ync` exposes the same `status` / `sync` / `pull` /
`push` / `install` operations to the model.
- **U

I in Settings → Config Sync** — status, per-item file lists, conflict
resolution, install and sync c

tings → Config Sync** — status, per-item file lists, conflict
resolution, install and sync controls.

## Quick start

1. Create a **private** Git repository for the synchronized configuration.
2. Create a Personal Acce

ss Token with `repo` (classic) or Contents read/write
(fine-grained) access to it.
3. Open **Setting

s → Config Sync**, enter the repository URL, branch and token,
then choose **Save and connect**.
4.

Choose **Sync now**. On another machine, install this plugin, enter the same
repository and token, a

nd sync.
5. Enable **Scheduled sync** or **Sync on startup** to keep the machines
converged.

## What syncs
| Item | Local source | Repository path | Default |

| Plugin manifest | `<profile>/package.json` | `profile/<profile>/package.json` | on |
| Local plugi
n source | directories of `link:` / `file:` / absolute dependencies | `local-plugins/<package>/…` |

on |
| Plugin configuration | `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` | `profile/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` |

on |
| Plugin data | files under `$DSH_HOME` listed in the settings page | `plugin-data/<path>` | on

|
| Dependency lock | `<profile>/pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml` | same | on |
| Other profi

le files | remaining profile config (presets, `config.toml`, …) | `profile/<profile>/…` | off |
| Sk
ills | `~/.agents/skills/`, `~/.agents/.skill-lock.json` | `skills/…` | off |

Files that look like credentials (`.env*`, `*credential*`, `*secret*`,
`id_rsa*`, `*.pem`, `.npmrc`,

`config.toml`, …) are excluded even when "Other
profile files" is on. A disabled item is neither re
ad, written nor deleted.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Every push stages exactly the paths the run changed, so unrelated files in the
same repository (anot

her profile, another tool) are never touched. A push that
loses a race with another machine is recom
puted and retried once — never forced.

State lives in `$DSH_HOME/anywhere-sync/` (`config.json`, `state.json`,
`credentials.json`, `repo/`,

`backups/`). The synced profile is the profile the
plugin is mounted in; the settings page shows it

ps/`). The synced profile is the profile the
plugin is mounted in; the settings page shows its name.
## Security

- The token is stored on this machine only, in
`$DSH_HOME/anywhere-sync/credentials.json` with mode

`0600`. It is passed to
git through a scoped `GIT_ASKPASS` environment variable, never written to th

e
repository, a URL, a log or a browser response.
- Alternative token sources: `ANYWHERE_SYNC_TOKEN`

, `GH_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- The HTTP API under `/anywhere-sync/api` reuses Harness Connection's

Host/Origin
and browser-login checks, falls back to loopback-only when that service is
absent, and r

equires a same-origin `Origin` on mutating requests.
- Synced files, account credentials, sessions a

nd workspaces are separate:
`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, session logs and workspace data are never re

ad.
- The agent tool cannot read the token, change the repository, or change the
selected sync items

.
- No telemetry, analytics or outbound requests except the configured Git remote.
## Requirements and supported platforms

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI and the plugin manager (the `settings.section`
and `webServer` se

rvices are used).
- Node.js 20+ in the Harness runtime; `git` on `PATH`.
- Designed for macOS, Linux

and Windows. CI runs the offline engine and HTTP
tests on Linux with Node 20 and 22; Windows path h

andling uses Node's `path`
APIs but is not exercised by CI.
## Limitations

- Text files only; a single file is capped at 5 MiB and larger files are
reported and skipped.
- Plu

gin packages themselves are not installed from the repository; the plugin
manifest and lock are sync

ed, then the profile package manager installs them.
- A pulled local plugin is registered as a depen

dency but its bundle is not
enabled automatically (that would reference a package before it is insta

lled).
- `profileFiles` and `skills` are off by default; sync them only after deciding
what may leav

e the machine.
- Git submodules, LFS and repository history cleanup are out of scope.
